Artdot: A solution to diamond art

Artdot is a brand focusing on developing and selling diamond painting kits, accessories & tools. We are passioned about deliver the best craft art experience to the users and foster long-term relationship with art enthusiastics and artisits. With years of experience and a diverse portfolio, we pride ourselves on our ability to make art accessible to every individual.

Welcome to ARTDOT!

Thank you for joining our Affiliate Program. These terms and conditions govern your participation in the program as both a merchant ("we" or "merchant") and an affiliate ("you" or "affiliate"). By participating in the program, you agree to comply with and be bound by these terms and conditions. If you do not agree with these terms in their entirety, you are not authorized to register or participate as an affiliate.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject any affiliate program registration at our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for rejecting your application.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

  • An affiliate link is automatically generated for you. You can also create links for specific products or collections.
  • If a person clicks on multiple affiliate links, the most recent link clicked will be credited.
  • Affiliates may or may not be assigned a unique coupon code, with details and usage clarified in the Dashboard.
  • If a customer uses both an affiliate link and a coupon code, commissions will not be doubled.
  • Affiliates without an assigned branded coupon are not authorized to promote the coupon.
  • Affiliates may promote the merchant’s website via online channels (e.g., Facebook, Instagram) or offline media (e.g., classified ads, magazines, newspapers).

3. Commissions and Payments

  • Commissions are calculated based on the Commission Structure and are dependent on the order value, excluding additional fees such as taxes and shipping costs.
  • To receive commissions, affiliates must specify payment details in the Settings. Payment schedules are provided in the Affiliate Guide.
  • Commissions are paid only for successfully completed transactions. Orders resulting in chargebacks or refunds are not eligible for commission.
  • The fair use policy grants the merchant the right to review all referral orders.
  • Commission status is displayed in the Commission Tab, and paid commissions are listed in the Payment Tab.

4. Marketing Tools

  • Affiliates can access promotional materials (e.g., banners, logos, or collection promotions) via the Marketing Tools Tab in the Dashboard.
  • Materials can be downloaded or embedded using provided HTML codes for affiliate channels.

5. Network Program

  • If the Network Tab is enabled, affiliates can invite others to join as downline affiliates.
  • Upline affiliates earn a network commission from the sales generated by their downline affiliates, based on merchant settings.
  • To invite others, share your unique network link. Affiliates who sign up through your link will automatically become your downline.

6. Cookie Tracking

  • We use cookies to track users who click on your affiliate link. Tracking is possible only if cookies are enabled on the user’s browser.
  • If a user disables or clears cookies, we cannot track their activity, and commissions cannot be paid for those transactions.
  • The cookie duration is specified in the Affiliate Registration Form. During this period, any purchases made by the referred user will automatically generate commissions for the affiliate.

7. Termination Policy

The merchant reserves the right to terminate an affiliate's participation in the program at its sole discretion for reasons including, but not limited to:

  • Violations of the terms and conditions.
  • Fraudulent activities.
  • Misrepresentation of the brand.
  • Non-compliance with promotional guidelines or ethical standards.

If an affiliate is terminated, all pending commissions may be forfeited at the merchant’s discretion. Affiliates may voluntarily leave the program by contacting marketing@artdot.com.

8. Dispute Resolution

If an affiliate disputes a commission, payment, or any other issue, they must notify the merchant in writing within 30 days of the transaction. Disputes will be reviewed and resolved at the merchant’s discretion. The decision made by the merchant will be final and binding.

9. Data Privacy Compliance

The merchant is committed to protecting affiliate and customer data in compliance with applicable data protection regulations, including GDPR and CCPA.

  • All data collected through the affiliate program will be used solely for program-related purposes.
  • For more details, refer to our Privacy Policy or contact us at marketing@artdot.com.

10. Affiliate Rules and Restrictions

Brand Name Usage

  • Affiliates are prohibited from using domains that include the ARTDOT brand name.
  • The brand name cannot be used in subdomains on the affiliate's own domain.
  • Affiliates may not bid on the brand's name, trademarks, variations, or misspellings on platforms like Google Ads, Adcenter, etc.
  • These restricted terms must also be set as negative matches in PPC campaigns.

Display and Linking Restrictions

  • Affiliates are not allowed to use display URLs containing the brand name.
  • Direct linking (including through content networks) is strictly prohibited.
  • Affiliates may not use pop-unders, adware, or similar tactics to promote the brand.

PPC Policy

TM Keywords Restrictions:

  • Bidding on "brand keywords" combinations is prohibited, except for terms like "brand coupon" or "brand voucher."
  • Landing pages for PPC campaigns must be the affiliate’s own website. Direct use of the brand’s official website is not permitted.

Keyword Bidding Rules:

  • Affiliates must avoid bidding on restricted keywords. Violations will result in the cancellation of commissions as compensation for non-compliance.

Go Forward and Refer!

We’re thrilled to have you as part of our Affiliate Program. You can always revisit these terms and conditions via your Dashboard. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us at marketing@artdot.com.

We wish you great success in your affiliate journey with ARTDOT!
